part: Two UI strings of the Hasawi Lomi Exhibition shop button (ui.ru)

ev.shop.ctx: /ru/events/ (EventsView card of the exhibition) and /ru/events/hasawi-lomi-exhibition/ (EventDetailView call-to-action row): label of a button opening the external online shop of the exhibition «Выставка лайма Аль-Ахсы» (published name), organised by the Al-Ahsa Chamber. It sits right next to the published sibling button «Забронировать билет» (ticketK) and must match its form: short, infinitive imperative, first word capitalised only, no final punctuation. The shop keeps selling after the exhibition dates end. Today the Russian button renders as an icon with an English aria-label because this key is missing.

ev.shopNote.en: Lomi products, foods and care items from the establishments taking part in the exhibition.
ev.shopNote.ar: منتجات اللومي ومأكولات ومستحضرات عناية من المؤسسات المشاركة في المعرض.
ev.shopNote.ctx: /ru/events/ (the exhibition card only): one short line printed under the shop button, saying what the shop sells. Exactly three categories: lomi products · foods · personal-care items — from the establishments (businesses/exhibitors) taking part in the exhibition. Lomi = «лайм» per the termbase (never «лимон»). A full sentence ending with a period. Nothing beyond the source (no «местные», «ручной работы», «семейные»). Published German sibling for reference only: «Lomi-Produkte, Lebensmittel und Pflegeprodukte der teilnehmenden Aussteller.»
